title: String _UID on ACPI0007 CPU objects
description: A string _UID violates the ACPI0007 integer requirement. It is also present in the collected live MR9A tables.
remediation: Per-board dynamic integer UID DSDTs. C1 local, C2 OS/firmware. Unique sentinels for unmapped entries; existing CPU/MADT identities are preserved. Grows 55 bytes.
